FR-APP-001.requirement: MarkHere shall launch from Start menu, Explorer file open, command line, and application executable.

FR-APP-002.requirement: Installed MarkHere shall use a single-instance coordinator by default.

FR-APP-003.requirement: MarkHere shall support multiple editor windows when requested.

FR-APP-004.requirement: MarkHere shall restore safe window geometry after normal restart.

FR-APP-005.requirement: MarkHere shall never close a window with unsaved work without a save/discard/cancel decision or an already configured safe autosave policy.

FR-APP-006.requirement: MarkHere shall expose an About view containing version, Electron/Chromium versions, license links, and third-party notices.

FR-FILE-003.requirement: `.mdx` may be opened as source text, but MarkHere shall not execute embedded JSX/JavaScript in v1.

FR-FILE-004.requirement: MarkHere shall create a new untitled Markdown document without immediately forcing a file location.

FR-FILE-005.requirement: Open-file dialog shall allow selecting multiple supported documents.

FR-FILE-006.requirement: Dragging supported files onto a window shall open them.

FR-FILE-007.requirement: A file already open in the same window shall not create an accidental duplicate tab unless explicit duplicate-view behavior exists.

FR-FILE-008.requirement: MarkHere shall handle Unicode filenames and paths.

FR-FILE-009.requirement: MarkHere shall handle spaces and `#`, `%`, `?`, `&`, parentheses, and brackets in local paths without treating them as URL syntax.

FR-FILE-010.requirement: Long-path behavior shall be tested and shall fail with an actionable error rather than truncated/corrupt paths.

FR-SAVE-001.requirement: Save shall write the current canonical Markdown buffer.

FR-SAVE-002.requirement: Save As shall update document identity only after successful write.

FR-SAVE-003.requirement: Writes shall use an atomic/replace strategy to minimize partial-file corruption.

FR-SAVE-004.requirement: MarkHere shall track dirty state by document revision, not by UI heuristics.

FR-SAVE-005.requirement: MarkHere shall preserve configured line ending (`LF` or `CRLF`) when saving.

FR-SAVE-006.requirement: MarkHere shall default new documents to UTF-8.

FR-SAVE-007.requirement: When opening a recognized non-UTF-8 encoding, MarkHere shall either preserve it safely or warn before conversion; silent mojibake is not acceptable.

FR-SAVE-008.requirement: The user shall be able to enable/disable autosave.

FR-SAVE-009.requirement: Recovery snapshots shall be independent of normal Save and shall not silently overwrite the user's document.

FR-PREV-001.requirement: Preview shall render Markdown without editing affordances.

FR-PREV-002.requirement: Preview shall support the application's selected Markdown dialect/extensions.

FR-PREV-003.requirement: Preview shall render relative local images through the approved resource layer.

FR-PREV-005.requirement: Preview shall render Mermaid using strict/sandbox-safe settings.

FR-PREV-007.requirement: Heading anchors shall be deterministic and navigable.

FR-PREV-008.requirement: Clicking an external HTTPS link shall leave MarkHere only through validated external-link handling.

FR-PREV-009.requirement: Local links to other Markdown documents shall open through MarkHere's file-opening service.

FR-WYS-001.requirement: MarkHere shall provide a visual Markdown editing mode derived from MarkText/Muya capabilities.

FR-WYS-002.requirement: WYSIWYG edits shall commit to the canonical document revision model.

FR-WYS-003.requirement: Headings, paragraphs, emphasis, strong, strikethrough, lists, blockquotes, links, images, tables, task lists, code, and thematic breaks shall be editable where supported by editor core.

FR-WYS-004.requirement: Math and diagram blocks shall provide an edit representation and rendered representation.

FR-WYS-005.requirement: Undo/redo shall not cross a mode transition in a way that corrupts or reverts committed document content.

FR-WYS-006.requirement: Pasting plain text shall not unexpectedly create HTML.

FR-WYS-007.requirement: Pasting an image shall follow the selected image-storage policy.

FR-SRC-001.requirement: MarkHere shall expose exact Markdown source editing.

FR-SRC-002.requirement: Source mode shall use syntax highlighting without altering source.

FR-SRC-003.requirement: Source mode shall support line numbers as a user preference.

FR-SRC-004.requirement: Source mode shall support find and replace.

FR-SRC-005.requirement: Source mode shall support standard editor commands and configurable keybindings.

FR-SRC-006.requirement: Switching from source to visual modes shall parse the latest source revision.

FR-SPLIT-001.requirement: Split mode shall show Source and Preview side by side.

FR-SPLIT-002.requirement: Preview shall update from source edits using a bounded debounce.

FR-SPLIT-003.requirement: Divider position shall be draggable and remembered per window preference.

FR-SPLIT-004.requirement: Scroll synchronization shall be available and disable-able.

FR-SPLIT-005.requirement: Scroll sync shall use structural anchors/relative mapping rather than assuming equal pixel heights.

FR-SPLIT-006.requirement: Split mode shall remain usable when preview rendering fails for a single diagram; one bad block must not blank the entire source editor.

FR-MD-001.requirement: Core parsing shall be measured against CommonMark 0.31.2 fixtures applicable to the chosen parser.

FR-MD-002.requirement: GFM tables shall render and round-trip.

FR-MD-003.requirement: GFM task-list items shall render and be editable.

FR-MD-004.requirement: GFM strikethrough shall render and edit.

FR-MD-005.requirement: GFM extended autolink behavior should be supported if compatible with inherited parser.

FR-MD-006.requirement: Fenced code blocks shall preserve language identifiers and exact code text.

FR-MD-007.requirement: Front matter shall be preserved exactly enough to avoid semantic data loss.

FR-MD-008.requirement: Unsupported extension syntax shall be preserved in source even when not visually editable.

FR-RES-001.requirement: Relative images shall resolve relative to the document location.

FR-RES-002.requirement: Workspace-relative and document-relative path rules shall be deterministic and documented.

FR-RES-003.requirement: Path traversal through rendered URLs shall not grant access outside approved scope.

FR-RES-004.requirement: Remote `http://` resources shall be blocked by default.

FR-RES-005.requirement: Remote `https://` images shall follow a user-controlled policy and must never gain Node/Electron privileges.

FR-RES-006.requirement: SVG shall be treated as active-capable content and sanitized or rasterized according to security policy.

FR-WS-001.requirement: User shall be able to open a directory as a workspace.

FR-WS-002.requirement: Workspace file tree shall update when files are added/renamed/deleted externally.

FR-WS-003.requirement: Workspace search shall support recursive text search with cancellation.

FR-WS-004.requirement: Search must exclude configured ignored directories and binary files.

FR-WS-005.requirement: Table of contents/outline shall be generated from document headings.

FR-WS-006.requirement: Recent files/workspaces shall be local metadata and user-clearable.

FR-EXP-004.requirement: Export shall snapshot a specific document revision.

FR-EXP-005.requirement: Export shall report progress phases and completion/failure.

FR-EXP-006.requirement: Cancellable exporters shall honor user cancellation.

FR-EXP-007.requirement: Export failures shall not crash or freeze the main editor.

FR-EXP-008.requirement: HTML/PDF/DOCX shall preserve headings, paragraphs, emphasis, lists, links, images, tables, code, and blockquotes at minimum.

FR-EXP-009.requirement: Mermaid/math shall have a documented export representation.

FR-EXP-010.requirement: MarkHere shall expose normal printing through a sanitized print representation.

FR-DOCX-001.requirement: H1-H6 shall map to Word heading styles, not simulated bold paragraphs.

FR-DOCX-002.requirement: Ordered/unordered lists shall use Word numbering definitions.

FR-DOCX-003.requirement: Markdown tables shall become native Word tables.

FR-DOCX-004.requirement: Local images shall be embedded in the DOCX package.

FR-DOCX-006.requirement: Code blocks shall preserve line breaks and use a code style.

FR-DOCX-007.requirement: Export shall not require Microsoft Word to be installed.

FR-DOCX-008.requirement: Future custom/reference templates shall not be required for v1.

FR-SET-001.requirement: Settings shall be versioned and migration-capable.

FR-SET-003.requirement: Default open mode shall be configurable among Preview/WYSIWYG/Source/Split.

FR-SET-005.requirement: Remote-resource policy shall be configurable with safe default.

FR-SET-006.requirement: Keybindings shall be configurable and resettable.

FR-SET-007.requirement: User shall be able to reset settings without deleting user documents.

FR-REC-001.requirement: Dirty documents shall periodically produce local recovery snapshots.

FR-REC-002.requirement: Recovery snapshots shall include enough identity/revision metadata to avoid applying a snapshot to the wrong file.

FR-REC-003.requirement: On abnormal termination, next launch shall present recoverable sessions instead of silently discarding them.

FR-REC-004.requirement: User can inspect, restore, save as, or discard recovered content.

FR-REC-005.requirement: Successful clean save/close shall eventually remove obsolete recovery state.

FR-UPD-001.requirement: Installed builds should support signed in-app updates.

FR-UPD-002.requirement: Update checks shall not upload Markdown document content.

FR-UPD-003.requirement: User can manually check for updates.

FR-UPD-004.requirement: Failed update shall not make currently installed MarkHere unusable.

NFR-SEC-001.requirement: Renderer shall run with `nodeIntegration: false`, `contextIsolation: true`, and `sandbox: true`.

NFR-SEC-002.requirement: Preload shall expose capability-specific methods, never raw `ipcRenderer`.

NFR-SEC-003.requirement: Main process shall validate IPC sender and all security-relevant inputs.

NFR-SEC-004.requirement: App UI should use a custom secure scheme instead of an unrestricted `file://` origin.

NFR-SEC-005.requirement: Content Security Policy shall reject arbitrary scripts/eval where dependencies permit.

NFR-SEC-006.requirement: Raw HTML, URLs, and SVG/resource content shall be sanitized/validated.

NFR-SEC-007.requirement: External protocol allowlist initially includes `https:` and `mailto:` only, with any additions explicitly reviewed.

NFR-SEC-008.requirement: Production Electron fuses shall disable capabilities MarkHere does not need.

NFR-SEC-009.requirement: Dependencies shall be scanned and reviewed before release.

NFR-SEC-010.requirement: Release artifacts shall be code-signed before public stable distribution.

NFR-REL-001.requirement: A failed save shall not mark a document clean.

NFR-REL-002.requirement: A successful atomic save must result in a complete file.

NFR-REL-003.requirement: External file changes shall never be knowingly overwritten without user policy/confirmation.

NFR-REL-004.requirement: Export errors shall be isolated from the editing session.

NFR-REL-006.requirement: App restart after renderer crash shall offer recovery where dirty data was persisted.

NFR-PERF-001.requirement: Cold start target <= 2.5 s to usable editor on agreed reference PC.

NFR-PERF-003.requirement: Preview update after split edit normally within 250 ms for ordinary documents.

NFR-PERF-004.requirement: No synchronous filesystem or export operation > 50 ms on renderer interaction path.

NFR-PERF-005.requirement: Export UI remains interactive and cancellable where supported.

NFR-PERF-006.requirement: Opening large files shall show progress/usable shell rather than appear hung.

NFR-COMP-002.requirement: Windows 11 ARM64 becomes supported only after native-dependency and installer verification.

NFR-COMP-003.requirement: Markdown save output should minimize unnecessary textual normalization to remain Git-friendly.

NFR-COMP-004.requirement: HTML export shall use UTF-8 and standards-based markup.

NFR-COMP-005.requirement: DOCX output shall be OOXML-compatible and not rely on Word automation.

NFR-MNT-001.requirement: Electron-specific code shall not leak into `document-model` or editor-core packages.

NFR-MNT-002.requirement: IPC contracts shall be defined in one typed source of truth.

NFR-MNT-004.requirement: Each persisted schema shall carry a version and migrations.

NFR-MNT-005.requirement: Core feature behavior shall be backed by automated tests before refactoring upstream-derived code.

NFR-PRIV-001.requirement: No account is required for core functionality.

NFR-PRIV-002.requirement: No document body shall be included in normal logs.

NFR-PRIV-003.requirement: No telemetry/crash upload is enabled by default in v1.

NFR-PRIV-004.requirement: Update checking shall reveal only normal update-request metadata required by the service.

NFR-PRIV-005.requirement: Diagnostic export shall be user-initiated and documented.
